description: Two image sequences over the same three stills — red, green, blue, in that order. The first holds each still 2 frames and loops: frames 0-1 red, 2-3 green, 4-5 blue, 6-7 red again, 8-9 green. The second holds each 3 frames and does not loop, on a clip one frame longer than it: 10-12 red, 13-15 green, 16-18 blue, and 19 still blue, its last still held rather than a hole. The frames sampled are the edges of holds. Off by one on either side of a hold means the timing is ffmpeg's rather than ours; red at 6 failing means the loop does not wrap; anything but blue at 19 means a clip past a non-looping end shows something other than the last still.
